response.sql: WITH order_execs AS (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.timespan, oe.fillcount FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault), order_avg_fills AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill FROM order_execs WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), timespan_means AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) as mean_fill FROM order_avg_fills GROUP BY timespan), filtered AS (SELECT oaf.ordersmark, oaf.timespan, oaf.avg_fill, oaf.avg_fill - tm.mean_fill as exceeds_figure FROM order_avg_fills oaf JOIN timespan_means tm ON oaf.timespan = tm.timespan WHERE oaf.avg_fill > tm.mean_fill), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, exceeds_figure, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) as rank FROM filtered) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, exceeds_figure, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rank
